races.paceDynamic: William F Browne and Game Point will set the early pace, but neither is a relentless galloper and both have fading tendencies. With most runners preferring hold-up tactics, the early pace will be moderate rather than punishing, allowing the leaders to stay in contention longer than usual. The lack of genuine pace pressure means this will develop into a tactical affair where positioning and timing matter more than raw speed. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace without getting detached, as the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground in what could become a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If William F Browne or Game Point can dictate fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets an easy lead and kicks clear when the field is still reorganizing. Hold-up horses get caught flat-footed by the change of gear from a tactical pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling slow with both leaders conserving energy
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure stamina test in the final half-mile where class tells. Patient jockeys can time their runs perfectly from the back of a strung-out field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strike
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge the leaders turning for home creating a genuine pace collapse
scenarios.body: Horses positioned in fourth or fifth can sweep past tired leaders and out-kick late closers. The race becomes about who holds their position best through the chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up in the straight with multiple first-time winners struggling
scenarios.body: Experience becomes crucial as several horses hit the front simultaneously. Jockey strength and tactical awareness determine the winner in a messy finish.

races.paceDynamic: Beir Bua will control this race from the front with a confirmed front-running style, setting a sustainable pace without pressure from other confirmed leaders. The majority of the field (12+ horses) are hold-up performers who will sit back and wait for their chance, creating a bunched field behind the leader. With minimal early pace pressure and a large group of closers, this creates a perfect storm for hold-up horses to unleash late finishing kicks. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late acceleration over the limited number of prominent racers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Beir Bua maintains an uncontested lead into the straight
scenarios.body: The packed field of hold-up horses will produce multiple finishing efforts in the final two furlongs, overwhelming the tiring leader. Strong finishers like Keilah, Louie's Folly, and the lightly-raced newcomers will benefit from the perfect tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent racers strike
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up brigade fail to coordinate their finishing kicks
scenarios.body: Beir Bua's sustained galloping or a prominent racer like Crystabel can capitalize on a disjointed finish from the large pack. The smaller group of forward runners avoid the traffic problems that could hamper the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Beir Bua sets an overly conservative pace throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where any horse with natural speed can win regardless of running style. This levels the playing field between all running styles but particularly benefits those with proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses are caught flat-footed by sustained pace
scenarios.body: Beir Bua's class advantage (OR 114) and tactical position prove decisive against a field that waits too long to make their moves. The leader's proven ability on good going gives him the edge in a staying battle.

races.paceDynamic: Bangor Lady will take the field along from the start with no other confirmed front runners to challenge her for the early lead. Bowgate Street and Jr Mahon may sit prominent but the pace will be controlled and sustainable rather than frantic. With 14 of 18 runners employing hold-up tactics, there will be a wall of horses queuing up behind the leaders turning for home. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners and those hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks, as the early pace will be moderate allowing closers to unleash late rallies.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Bangor Lady dictates a steady gallop without pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate early fractions will allow the better hold-up horses to close strongly in the final furlong. Horses with class and finishing speed will benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Bowgate Street and Jr Mahon press forward early
scenarios.body: The prominent runners will steal crucial lengths by staying closer to the pace while the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic. Those positioned handily will have first run on the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Special
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the middle stages
scenarios.body: An ultra-slow tempo will turn this into a sprint finish where the freshest finishers can produce explosive late bursts. Class horses who travel well off the pace will thrive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals
scenarios.trigger: If Bangor Lady gets uncontested fractions and kicks clear
scenarios.body: With no pressure early, she could establish a winning margin before the field responds. Her light weight and front-running style could prove decisive.

races.paceDynamic: Lady's Choice will lead from the start with only Ladiam, Lariat, and Button Rock likely to track her early. This creates a moderate pace with no serious pressure on the leader through the first circuit. The bulk of the field are hold-up horses who will be content to settle in behind, creating a bunched pack turning for home. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and hold-up horses with tactical speed, as they'll have first run on a potentially over-racing leader who has never won and fades in the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses pounce late
scenarios.trigger: If Lady's Choice sets steady fractions and the pace quickens from 3f out
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up brigade get ideal positioning as the leader weakens, with the best-rated horses able to showcase their class in a driving finish. Quality emerges as stamina becomes crucial in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker takes over
scenarios.trigger: If Ladiam or Button Rock press Lady's Choice earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and gives the prominent runners first run, allowing them to kick clear before the hold-up horses can respond. Early positioning proves decisive with less kick needed late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained battle develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple hold-up horses hit the front together turning in
scenarios.body: A war of attrition develops with 4-5 horses locked together in the final quarter-mile, favouring those with the best recent form and strongest finishes. Pure stamina and determination decide the outcome.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Leader stays strong
scenarios.trigger: If Lady's Choice gets uncontested fractions and finds extra when challenged
scenarios.body: The mare defies her poor recent record by capitalizing on perfect tactical conditions, holding off late challengers through superior fitness. Front-running tactics pay off in a slowly-run contest.

races.paceDynamic: Earl Neigh and Survivors Sister will dispute the early lead, with Earl Neigh looking the more reliable pace-setter given his consistent front-running style and Philip Donovan's aggressive riding. Le Grand Vert, Jumping Susie, and Portarlington will track closely in the prominent positions, creating a good gallop over this stamina-testing trip. The strong pace will stretch the field early, with the hold-up horses needing to overcome significant ground in the closing stages. This honest gallop over 3m2f clearly favours prominent runners who can travel well in the slipstream and kick clear when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Earl Neigh sets honest fractions and the pace holds strong throughout
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will suit horses like Le Grand Vert and Jumping Susie who can sit handy and pounce when the leaders weaken. Hold-up horses will find too much ground to make up over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes unsustainable and the leaders collapse dramatically
scenarios.body: The Miracle Man or Ballyglass Beauty could time their runs perfectly to sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. Their stamina reserves and finishing kicks become decisive assets.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Earl Neigh gets an uncontested lead and steadies the tempo mid-race
scenarios.body: Earl Neigh could dictate terms and kick clear approaching the last, with his class and freshness overcoming the extended absence. Survivors Sister might also benefit from any tactical slowdown.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders tire dramatically and the race becomes a sprint finish between mid-division runners
scenarios.body: Gerrys Wish and Evans Secret could emerge from the pack with late runs, benefiting from the class advantage when others have emptied their tanks. The pace meltdown creates opportunities for patient tactics.
